summary: Iteration 465 — Full backend + frontend validation of the new AI Revenue Strategist module (/api/strategist/*, RevenueStrategistPanel.js). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests PASS (config GET/PUT with validation for language TR/EN + horizon 30/90/365, config persistence, reset, reports listing shape validation with all required fields incl. situation_report/market_analysis/past_performance/what_was_done/risks/opportunities/recommendations/kpis, apply-already-applied → 400, dismiss flow success, apply of unknown action → 404, unknown report → 404). Did NOT re-invoke /analyze (respecting the ≤2 LLM-call cap — main agent already ran once, this iteration ran zero). Frontend E2E via Playwright: login OK → Revenue & rates sidebar section expands → 'AI Strateji Robotu' opens revenue-strategist-panel → existing dev report renders immediately with hero, horizon buttons (30/90/365), TR/EN toggles, auto-apply checkbox, KPI strip (5 tiles), 4 report sections, risks/opportunities cards, and 6 recommendations. Interaction flows verified: (a) clicking strategist-apply-{aid} for a restriction action produced 'Uygulandı' green badge and hid the Uygula/Yoksay buttons; (b) clicking strategist-dismiss-{aid} produced 'Yoksayıldı' grey badge; (c) auto-apply checkbox toggled false→true and persisted (verified via subsequent GET /config). Auto_apply reset to false at end (verified via API — final state: {auto_apply:false, language:'tr', horizon_days:90}). No stray rate_overrides added by this iteration beyond what apply-on-restriction inserted (restriction actions write to restriction_recommendations, not rate_overrides).
critical_code_review_comments: revenue_strategist.py is 413 lines — well organised (config/intel/prompt/apply/router are cleanly separated). Silently dropping invalid language/horizon in PUT /config is user-friendly but arguably should return 400 for stricter API contract; current behaviour is acceptable and covered by tests.
_apply_price_action correctly upserts by (property_id,date) and caps at 120 days — good guard against runaway date ranges from bad LLM output.

Auto-apply guard uses |target - base_rate|/base_rate ≤ 15% instead of the CURRENT rate for that date — could over-apply in situations where an override already brought that date's rate far from base_rate. Not a bug per spec (spec says 'low-risk ≤15% price changes'), but consider comparing against current effective rate for that date instead of a global base_rate.

RevenueStrategistPanel renders KPI, sections, and recommendations conditionally on `report` — the 'MISSING' snapshot for kpis/recommendations at t=0 in my test was just because the initial GET hadn't resolved yet; a loading skeleton would be a nice touch but not required.

Every interactive element has data-testid — excellent testability (horizon-30/90/365, lang-tr/en, autoapply-toggle, analyze-btn, apply-{aid}, dismiss-{aid}, action-{aid}, risks, opportunities, recommendations, report-meta, history-select, empty).
